articles.summary: Backpacks go through a lot in a school year. They sit on classroom floors, ride in cars and buses, carry water bottles, hold half-finished snacks, and somehow collect crumbs in pockets you barely use. The good news: keeping a backpack clean does not have to be complicated. With a few simple habits, regular spot checks, and the right care routine, you can help your backpack stay fresh from the first day of school through the last. And when you start with a washable, well-organized Vera Bradley backpack, everyday messes are much easier to manage. Start With a Weekly Backpack Cleanout The easiest way to keep a backpack clean is to stop little messes from becoming bigger ones. Once a week, empty every compartment and shake out crumbs, scraps of paper, pencil shavings, receipts, wrappers, and anything else that has settled at the bottom. Shop the Large Bancroft Backpack Check smaller pockets, too. Pens, lip balm, snacks, sticky notes, and loose change are easy to forget, but they are often the source of stains, smells, and clutter. 💡 Pro Tip: It can be hard to keep track of all the little things you might need every day. Try a small pouch or two to hold those extras in your backpack. Having them all zipped in one place makes them easy to find, plus it’s a breeze to pull out the pouch when it’s cleanout time. Keep Food and Drinks Contained Snacks and water bottles are usually the biggest backpack mess-makers. Use a lunch bag or reusable container instead of dropping food directly into a backpack pocket. For water bottles, use exterior side pockets whenever possible so leaks are less likely to spread to books, papers, or your laptop. This is where backpack design matters. Styles with side bottle pockets, zip compartments, and interior organization make it easier to separate school supplies, snacks, tech, and personal items. 💡 Pro Tip: Hydration is great. A loose water bottle rolling around inside your bag? Not so much. Look for a backpack like Vera Bradley’s Large Bancroft Backpack which has a side pocket with elastic and a pleat to fit a variety of different-sized bottles. Store Pens, Pencils, and Small Supplies An uncapped pen can do a lot of damage in a backpack. Keep writing tools in a pencil pouch or dedicated pocket instead of loose in the main compartment. Choose a backpack that has pen slips, zip pockets, and interior compartments to keep smaller supplies from rolling around. Bonus: you know exactly where your pen is when you need it! Shop Vera Bradley Backpacks Choose Easy-to-Clean Materials Some backpack messes are unavoidable but the right material can make cleanup a lot easier. When you’re shopping for a school backpack, look for fabrics that are designed to handle everyday use and are easy to clean when life gets messy. And always follow the manufacturer’s recommended cleaning instructions when it comes time for a refresh. Vera Bradley’s backpacks not only look great, they are a durable, practical pick. In fact, our quilted Premium Cotton backpacks can actually be tossed in the washing machine to take off that mid-school year grime. Follow these steps to keep your backpack looking like new: How to Clean a Vera Bradley Backpack 1. Before washing your quilted cotton Vera Bradley backpack, empty it completely. Check every pocket, remove loose items, and shake out crumbs or debris. 2. Close all zippers and closures before placing the bag in the washing machine. 3. Wash in cold water on a gentle cycle with mild detergent. 4. Line dry or lay your backpack flat to dry to help maintain its shape. Have a Featherweight backpack? Skip the washing machine – clean stains with a soft, damp cloth and gentle detergent, then rinse thoroughly and lay flat to dry. How Often Should You Clean Your Backpack? For backpacks that get everyday use, a little routine maintenance goes a long way. Do a quick cleanout once a week and spot clean any spills or stains that pop up. If your backpack is machine washable, do a more thorough wash cycle each semester to remove lingering odors and start fresh. Empty it, organize it, wipe what needs wiping, and wash when needed. That is the simplest way to keep your backpack looking newer for longer! A Great Day Starts With a Clean Backpack Your backpack carries your whole day. Choosing a washable, thoughtfully-designed backpack makes it easier to handle real-life messes without letting them take over. With regular cleanouts, smart packing habits, and the right care routine, your backpack can stay fresh, organized, and ready for whatever the school year brings! SHOP ALL SCHOOL BACKPACKS
articles.title: How to Keep Your Backpack Clean (and Looking New All Year)

articles.summary: Not every summer bag needs to be photographed next to a passport and a poolside drink. Some bags are built for the summer you’re actually having: workdays, errands, shuttling kids to summer camps and activities, grocery runs, lunch dates, and that one quick stop that somehow turns into five. For days like those, Vera Bradley’s lightweight purses and handbags bring the personality without asking you to overpack your life. The Original Vera Tote: For the Woman Who Carries the Day Some bags whisper, "You’ve got this." The Original Vera Tote shows up with six interior slip pockets and says, "Already handled!" This classic large tote is made for anyone whose day does not fit neatly into one tiny compartment. With a roomy interior, zip closure, exterior slip and zip pockets, it’s one of those everyday tote bags for women that earns its place fast. Laptop? Notebook? Water bottle? Snacks you absolutely meant to share? There’s space. The Original Vera Tote has a timeless, polished shape that works from weekday to weekend. It is structured enough to feel pulled together, practical enough to use constantly, and expressive enough to remind everyone that dependable does not mean dull. "Great color and print especially for summer." ~ Rose The Branning Tote: Minimal Effort, Maximum "I Meant to Look This Good" The Branning Tote is for the days when you want your bag to do its job beautifully and not make a whole speech about it. Light, soft, and simple, this effortless carryall is easy to throw over your shoulder and take wherever the day points you. Its clean silhouette gives it a refined everyday feel, while its spacious design makes it useful for work, errands, or casual summer outings. For anyone searching for a great everyday bag for women, this tote makes a strong case without trying too hard. Which, frankly, is very chic of it. The Mini Roxbury Crescent Shoulder Bag: Small Bag, Main Character Energy There is no rule that practical has to mean oversized. Our Mini Roxbury Crescent Shoulder Bag is the purse option for casual days, fun nights, and moments when you only want the essentials tagging along. Its sleek crescent shape brings a modern finish to summer outfits, while the zip closure and interior slip pocket help keep the little things from staging a disappearance. Compact, lightweight, and easy to wear, it's made for the woman who knows exactly what she needs and does not feel the need to carry the rest of the household just in case. A little polish. A little personality. A lot of "yes, this counts as being prepared." "Beautiful spring summer purse." ~ Lizbeth The Original Zip Hipster: Hands-Free, Because You Have Things to Do The Original Zip Hipster is your crossbody choice for summer days that involve movement, multitasking, and carrying an iced coffee like it is a personality trait. We support this. This bag is designed to keep essentials organized and easy to reach. You’ll love the: • three zippered compartments • exterior zip pocket • interior zip pocket • adjustable longer strap It’s one of those everyday crossbody bags for women that feels made for errands, day trips, walks, farmers markets, and any plan where hands-free is not a preference but a lifestyle. Because digging for your keys at the bottom of a bag in 89-degree weather? Absolutely not. "It's a great 'medium' size, holding everything I need, without being too heavy." ~ Nancy The Large Berkhill Backpack: For the Day That Starts at Dawn and Runs Long Our Large Berkhill Backpack is built for busy days with a little more going on. Lightweight, casual, and ready for whatever the day brings, it offers the kind of organization that makes you feel slightly more in control of your calendar. We love a bag with emotional range. This backpack has all the features you need: • two exterior zip pockets • two side pockets - toss your water bottle in one and a spare in the other! • trolley sleeve for your next trip • multiple interior pockets • comfortable, adjustable straps • room for up to a 15-inch laptop The Large Berkhill Backpack is ideal for commuting, travel days, work sessions, and packed summer schedules. It has space for the useful things, the backup things, and the "I might need this" things. No judgment. Casual Summer Handbags for the Life You Actually Live The right bag does not need to wait for a boarding pass. These casual summer handbags are made for real days, real outfits, and real women who already know what works for them. Whether you reach for a roomy tote, a compact shoulder bag, a hands-free crossbody, or a laptop-friendly backpack, the point is not to look like you’re on vacation. Carry what you need in a way that feels light, useful, expressive, and unmistakably yours! SHOP YOUR NEW FAVORITE EVERYDAY BAG
